definitions.explanation: The systematic examination of data, phenomena, or structures to understand their components and relationships. Used in scientific, technical, and mathematical contexts.
In computing and linguistics, the process of breaking down data or text into its component parts for interpretation.

examples.japanese: データを{解析|かいせき}する。
{解析|かいせき}{結果|けっか}をレポートにまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled the analysis results into a report.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}チームが{事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}を{詳|くわ}しく{解析|かいせき}している。
examples.english: A team of specialists is conducting a detailed analysis of the cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: ログを{解析|かいせき}する。
AIが{文章|ぶんしょう}を{自動的|じどうてき}に{解析|かいせき}する。
examples.english: The AI automatically parses the text.

examples.japanese: このツールは{大量|たいりょう}のテキストデータを{高速|こうそく}で{解析|かいせき}できる。
examples.english: This tool can parse large amounts of text data at high speed.

notes:
USAGE:
A technical term common in science, engineering, IT, and mathematics. Often used as a suru-verb ({解析|かいせき}する). The word carries a more technical nuance than {分析|ぶんせき}, which is the more general word for analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{解析|かいせき} (data analysis)
- {解析|かいせき}{結果|けっか} (analysis results)
- {構文|こうぶん}{解析|かいせき} (syntactic parsing)
- {数値|すうち}{解析|かいせき} (numerical analysis)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分析|ぶんせき}: analysis — more general, used in everyday and business contexts
- {調査|ちょうさ}: investigation, survey — broader in scope, not necessarily technical
